description: Max searches for her fellow X5 escapees while helping Logan’s Eyes Only investigations, staying ahead of Lydecker and Manticore as fragments of her engineered past return to threaten the life she has built in Seattle.

s01e01-02.description: Genetically engineered fugitive Max Guevara crosses paths with cyber-journalist Logan Cale, whose search for justice offers her new resources to find the other children who escaped Manticore with her.

s01e03.description: Max reunites with the woman who sheltered her after the Manticore escape, but Lydecker’s pursuit closes in as changes in Max’s engineered biology become impossible to ignore.

s01e04.description: When Max is jailed after trying to obtain the medication that controls her seizures, Logan and Original Cindy uncover a corrupt warden with ties to Lydecker and race to get her out.

s01e05.description: Max helps Sketchy escape a dishonest casino owner while Logan investigates the suspicious death of a client’s father, pulling both of them into separate battles over money and loyalty.

s01e06.description: A lead on another escaped X5 sends Max searching through her past, while Logan’s former girlfriend returns and Normal’s treatment of Herbal creates trouble at Jam Pony.

s01e07.description: A hostage crisis at a genetics conference traps Max with Lydecker, forcing the enemies to cooperate while Logan looks for leverage that can get the captives out alive.

s01e08.description: Max, Logan and Zack pursue the kidnappers of a fellow transgenic and discover that Lydecker may not be the only force hunting Manticore’s escaped creations.

s01e09.description: Max becomes the target of a citywide manhunt after a murder is tied to her, while Logan’s worsening spinal injury forces Max to consider a dangerous way to help him walk again.

s01e10.description: A promised night out with Max is interrupted when Logan pursues a trafficker targeting vulnerable women, leaving their personal plans tangled with another Eyes Only investigation.

s01e11.description: Max is hired to protect a federal witness whose past mirrors some of her own, only to find herself hunted by enhanced soldiers with abilities that rival hers.

s01e12.description: At a wealthy family wedding, Max becomes entangled in the theft of a valuable painting when the forgers responsible abduct Normal and force Jam Pony into the mess.

s01e13.description: Enhanced soldiers abduct Original Cindy to draw Max into the open, while Max discovers that her own genetic makeup may hold the key to both their survival and Logan’s recovery.

s01e14.description: After Zack escapes Lydecker, Max joins him in trying to gather the scattered X5 fugitives before Manticore can reclaim them, even as her bond with Logan deepens.

s01e15.description: A fellow Manticore experiment hunts a doctor connected to their past, forcing Max to choose between protecting an old friend and helping Logan as Lydecker tightens his control.

s01e16.description: A quiet weekend outside Seattle turns dangerous when Max helps a troubled boy who claims to see the dead while Logan investigates the murders of local activists.

s01e17.description: A mission to steal sensitive computer data is derailed when Original Cindy’s criminal ex returns, drawing Max into a chase involving a pharmaceutical company and information with wider consequences.

s01e18.description: A series of bodies bearing X5 barcodes convinces Max that one of the Manticore escapees has become a killer, forcing her to hunt someone she once considered family.

s01e19.description: A mysterious vigilante joins Max and Logan’s hunt for a murderer released from prison, while Logan discovers that his own family has an uncomfortable connection to the case.

s01e20.description: Max, Zack and Tinga try to keep Tinga’s young son out of Lydecker’s hands, but a brainwashed Brin and Manticore’s interest in the child turn the rescue into a trap.

s01e21.description: Max’s feline DNA sends her hormones out of control just as Logan begins seeing someone else, while Lydecker and the X5 fugitives maneuver toward a confrontation with Manticore.

s01e22.description: Lydecker joins forces with Max and the other escaped X5s to strike at Manticore, but the assault ends in tragedy and leaves Logan facing a devastating choice.
